blockers: P0 self-package acceptance still requires Product Owner plus A1-A6 representative review and a recorded successful cross-vendor protocol dry run.
Protected CI and branch protection require an authorized repository administrator.

G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending, with the documented external product, Meta, Stripe, legal/PDPA, usability, qualified-reviewer, and storage-drill evidence still open.
next_action: Keep the work-package manifest in_review. Integration/Product owners must close the remaining P0 acceptance and G0 evidence through their independent records; do not infer G0 approval from this reviewer/security status.
